ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer Bodge Jobs
ModMetaData.author: Zapdude; based on Multiplayer Compatibility by the RimWorld Multiplayer Team
ModMetaData.description:
Multiplayer Bodge Jobs: a fork of Multiplayer Compatibility for RimWorld 1.6. The project is MIT licensed; PATCHES.md lists the fork's changes and their upstream status, NOTICE.md records provenance.
Do not enable this together with the original Multiplayer Compatibility. This fork carries its own package id, so the game will not stop you.
Requires Multiplayer Bodged, the fork of Multiplayer.
Adds sync for the customization commit of Persona Weapons Unbound and Unique Weapons Unbound, and guards the Vanilla Fishing Expanded handler against the Odyssey build.
